commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Half-chance! Mathys Tel (Tottenham) plays a pass into the box, but Robert Sanchez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+7' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
90+6' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
90+4' James Maddison (Tottenham) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
90+3' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Tottenham.
90+2' Dario Essugo (Chelsea) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90+2' Chelsea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

82' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) on the edge of the box.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Wesley Fofana will be replaced by Mamadou Sarr (Chelsea).

72' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
71' Neat passing move from Tottenham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Substitution. James Maddison (Tottenham) in, Randal Kolo Muani out.

23' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call.
21' Liam Delap (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

6' Stuart Attwell has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joao Palhinha (Tottenham).
5' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass. Now Tottenham have a corner.
3' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
